Q8528.reason: Sudden chest pain with a new aortic regurgitation murmur, wide pulse pressure, and bilaterally decreased femoral pulses in a hypertensive smoker is classic aortic dissection.

Q8529.reason: Nonpurulent cellulitis needs strep/staph coverage, and clindamycin is appropriate given anaphylaxis to penicillin and a macrolide rash that rules out amoxicillin and clarithromycin.

Q8530.reason: The apex (tip) of the tongue drains first to the submental lymph nodes, so those are the nodes to check first for metastasis.
